Your holdings: SOXL (-52.13%) and SPAL (-30.89%) are leveraged ETFs marked "SELL" and are your biggest concern. Leveraged products decay and margin amplifies these deep drawdowns. QQQI (-3.28%) is also flagged for a "TRIM."

Watch: Keep a close eye on the 10-year Treasury yield and any further developments in the Middle East, as both could quickly shift market sentiment and impact your tech positions.

Bottom line: Prioritize managing your leveraged positions and be highly selective with any new tech exposure given the current headwinds.
plays: SOXL: Consider exiting this leveraged position given the deep drawdown (-52.13%) and "SELL" status; margin amplifies losses.
SPAL: Review your stop at 21.38 or consider trimming this leveraged ETF, also marked "SELL" with a significant loss (-30.89%).
